build: release, CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=1, system-openblas, local strided patch, RUSTC_WRAPPER empty
provider: OpenBLAS 0.3.26 LP64 pthreads, existing authorized OpenBLAS diagnostic Docker image
metric: whole-process N3-N1 Ir divided by added contractions; median paired percentage reduction
scope: Warmed eager operation including intrinsic allocations; fixed setup cancels; per-repeat harness overhead remains. Not a kernel-only or native timing measurement.
validity: All cases and pairs required, successful exits and numerical checks required, same 1T environment and CPU16 affinity. Incomplete runs or configuration/numerical failures invalidate the whole comparison. Inspect provider GEMM self-cost changes rather than assume invariance.
host_noise: Record active workloads and CPU16 L3 topology; any competing native workload precludes native timing acceptance. Instruction diagnostics remain allowed; no native speedup will be inferred.
integration: CPU/AD library, integration, UI and doctest gate completed; native timings, thread matrix, broader gates and formal dependency integration remain outstanding. Formal integration deliberately deferred.
